summary: You have a solid, consistent profile across all your competencies, sitting in the 71-78% range. Your capstone work (Project Management, Industry Standards, Technical Communication) is genuinely strong, while your core Data Structures and Algorithms and Object-Oriented Design competencies show as gaps largely because of a recurring theme in marker feedback: results are sound but would improve with clearer reasoning, tighter technical precision and more complete testing and evaluation. Focusing your study on that same skill of justification and evaluation will lift the two gap areas without needing to relearn content you already grasp.

priorities.evidence: This is your persistent gap at 71.5% (CSE1OOF 73.5%, CSE2ALG 71.0%), stable across subjects. Your lowest score here was CSE2ALG:Central examination at 70.0%, and across all three CSE2ALG assessments markers repeatedly asked for clearer reasoning, better technical precision and more complete testing or reflection.
priorities.actions: Revisit the CSE2ALG:Central examination and CSE2ALG:Assignment feedback and, for each algorithm or data structure choice you made, write a short justification comparing it against an alternative (CSE2ALG:SILO4). Re-attempt a searching/sorting implementation in Java (CSE2ALG:SILO3) and add explicit performance measurements to evaluate it (CSE2ALG:SILO5), documenting your test cases to address the 'more complete testing' comment.

priorities.evidence: This is an isolated gap at 73.5%, evidenced only by CSE1OOF. Your CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration (71.0%) and CSE1OOF:Central examination (73.0%) were your weakest here, and markers noted you should provide clearer reasoning, improve technical precision and show more complete testing or reflection.
priorities.actions: Re-work the CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration task, this time designing a small real-life program (CSE1OOF:SILO4) and explicitly noting where you reuse code through inheritance or composition (CSE1OOF:SILO3). Review the CSE1OOF:Central examination feedback and practise writing analysis/design/implementation reasoning that shows how objects combine data structure and behaviour (CSE1OOF:SILO1), adding test cases and reflection to each solution.
